environment.description: Same Django REST API on EC2 in a VPC. The S3 VPC Gateway Endpoint (vpce-0f9e8d7c6b5a43210) has a restrictive endpoint policy with a Condition block using StringEquals on 's3:prefix' and a resource constraint. The endpoint policy allows s3:GetObject/PutObject/DeleteObject ONLY when aws:ResourceAccount matches '123456789012' AND the request targets resources matching 'arn:aws:s3:::company-docs-staging/*' OR 'arn:aws:s3:::company-docs-staging'. A secondary Deny statement explicitly denies any s3:* action where s3:ExistingObjectTag/classification equals 'restricted'. The EC2 instance has no internet gateway route and ALL S3 traffic must traverse this VPC endpoint. Instance role trust policy includes a condition requiring aws:ViaAWSService or aws:SourceVpce to match the endpoint ID.

config.route_table: no igw route, only vpce-0f9e8d7c6b5a43210 for s3 prefix list pl-63a5400a
